edits.value_json: "火 names a star in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. The oracle-bone passage may refer to 火星 but does not specify 心宿二 or the planet Mars; 火星 here is understood as the historical short name for 大火/心宿二. The evidence does not establish the name’s motivation or its link to literal ‘fire’."
